Table 1:Performance comparison on OVO-Bench RT+BT (%).Avg. is the question-weighted accuracy over all questions of a category (837 real-time, 631 backward-tracing), and
Overall is the accuracy over all 1,468 questions; prior methods are aggregated from their published per-task accuracies in the same way.
Gray rows are backbone references,RSIdenotes recursively evolved harnesses, and†marks results of our
reimplementation.
Within each backbone,boldandunderlinedscores mark the best and second-best methods.

Table 2:Performance comparison on StreamingBench and StreamBench (%).StreamingBench Avg. is the question-weighted accuracy over its four subsets, and StreamBench uses its official LLM-judged protocol. GPT-4o uses 64 frames for StreamingBench
and 50 for StreamBench[55].
Gray rows are backbone references, purpleRSItags denote recursively evolved harnesses, and†marks results of
our reimplementation.
Within each backbone,boldandunderlinedscores mark the best and second-best methods.

Figure 5:Memory of the final harness at question time on three OVO-Bench test questions(tasks EPM, ASI,
and FPD). Questions and options are reproduced verbatim. Each panel gives the question, its options (green: correct;
red: the seed’s choice), and both answers with
the probabilityP⁡(gold)P(\text{gold})of the correct option. The timeline shows what the write path stored from the start
of the video to the question (black marker).Notes: captions every 16 s, chapter notes over four captions,
and a step log of who does what (purple outline: steps cited in the answer prompt).Index: ViCLIP vectors of
16-s segments and 4-frame windows, darker when closer to the question and options.Frames: the 64-frame store
(tall ticks: segment key frames; pale ticks: frames since forgotten).Tools: OWLv2 detections, dark if the
noun is named in the question or options.Read: the frames sent to the VLM, retrieved key frames in purple and
the 4 most recent frames in gray. Thumbnails show six of them with the selector that chose each: similarity to the
question (CLIP,ViCLIP index), temporal coverage (recency,gap fill,caption gap),
or the last strong scene change (visual change). The seed sends only the captions and the 4 most recent
frames.
